flowchart LR
    %% ── Style Definition matching Figure 3.1e ──
    classDef default fill:#ffffff,stroke:#000000,stroke-width:1.5px,color:#000000;
    classDef thickBox fill:#ffffff,stroke:#000000,stroke-width:2.5px,color:#000000,font-weight:bold;
    classDef modalBox fill:#ffffff,stroke:#000000,stroke-width:1.5px,stroke-dasharray: 4 4,color:#000000;

    %% ── 1. Authentication Tier (Left) ──
    Login["Login Screen"]:::thickBox
    ErrorToast["Error Toast"]:::modalBox
    Login -.->|"Invalid Creds"| ErrorToast

    FaceScan["Face Scan Screen"]:::default
    RetryAuth["Retry / Fallback"]:::modalBox
    FaceScan -.->|"Match Fail"| RetryAuth
    RetryAuth -.->|"Use Password"| Login

    Register["Register Screen"]:::thickBox
    ValToast["Validation Toast"]:::modalBox
    FaceReg["Face Register Screen"]:::default
    Register -.->|"Validation Fail"| ValToast
    Register -->|"Valid Form"| FaceReg
    FaceReg -->|"Capture Success"| Login
    FaceReg -.->|"Cancel"| Login

    Login -->|"Select Face ID"| FaceScan
    Login -->|"Select Register"| Register

    %% ── 2. Central Hub ──
    MemberHome["Member Home Screen"]:::thickBox
    Login -->|"Valid Creds"| MemberHome
    FaceScan -->|"Match Success"| MemberHome

    %% ── 3. Branch 1: Search & Discovery ──
    Search["Voice/Text Search Screen"]:::default
    EmptySearch["Empty View / Retry"]:::modalBox
    Search -.->|"No Match / Timeout"| EmptySearch
    MemberHome -->|"Search Bar"| Search

    %% ── 4. Branch 2: Recipes ──
    Recipe["Recipe Screen"]:::default
    SuggestAlt["Suggest Alternatives"]:::modalBox
    Recipe -.->|"Ingredient OutOfStock"| SuggestAlt
    MemberHome -->|"Recipe Banner"| Recipe

    %% ── 5. Branch 3: Product Details & Cart ──
    ProdDetail["Product Detail Screen"]:::thickBox
    HealthBanner["Health Warning Banner"]:::modalBox
    SimilarProd["Show Similar Products"]:::modalBox
    ProdDetail -.->|"Allergy / Diet Violation"| HealthBanner
    ProdDetail -.->|"OutOfStock"| SimilarProd

    Search -->|"Results Found"| ProdDetail
    Recipe -->|"Valid Recipe"| ProdDetail

    Cart["Cart Screen"]:::thickBox
    EmptyCart["Empty Cart View"]:::modalBox
    Cart -.->|"Empty Cart"| EmptyCart

    ProdDetail -->|"Add to Cart"| Cart
    Recipe -->|"Add Ingredients"| Cart
    MemberHome -->|"Tap 'Cart' Tab"| Cart

    NavMap["Navigation Map Screen"]:::thickBox
    Cart -->|"Calculate Route"| NavMap

    %% ── 6. Branch 4: Profile & Member Management ──
    Profile["Profile Screen"]:::thickBox
    MemberHome -->|"Tap 'Profile' Tab"| Profile

    PersonalInfo["Personal Info Screen"]:::default
    ShopPrefs["Shopping Preferences Screen"]:::thickBox
    MemberTier["Member Tier Screen"]:::default
    OrderHistory["Order History Screen"]:::default
    FaceUpdate["Face Update Screen"]:::default
    AutoLogout["Auto Logout -> Login"]:::modalBox

    Profile -->|"Tap 'Personal Info'"| PersonalInfo
    PersonalInfo -->|"Update Biometrics"| FaceUpdate
    Profile -->|"Tap 'Preferences'"| ShopPrefs
    Profile -->|"Tap 'Member Tier'"| MemberTier
    Profile -->|"Tap 'Order History'"| OrderHistory
    Profile -.->|"Token Expired 401"| AutoLogout
    Profile -.->|"User Logout"| Login
